classification_legend.A_LEGACY_PRESENT: Legacy capability established, but no stronger SWAP5 disposition can be made.
classification_legend.B_SW5_TYPED_PRODUCTION: Typed production route is admitted in its stated capability scope.
classification_legend.C_SW5_RESTRICTED_PRODUCTION: Typed production route is admitted only for an explicit restricted profile/composition.
classification_legend.D_QUALIFICATION_ONLY: Implemented/qualified evidence exists but canonical production admission or normal application reachability is absent.
classification_legend.E_PRESERVED_BUT_NOT_TYPED: Preserved through legacy/reference execution but not owned by a typed production route.
classification_legend.F_NOT_YET_MIGRATED: Relevant legacy/product capability lacks a complete typed production route.
classification_legend.G_INTENTIONALLY_EXCLUDED: Capability is explicitly out of SWAP5 target scope.
classification_legend.H_AUTHORITY_UNCLEAR: Current repository evidence cannot resolve the exact authority or complete legacy semantics without overclaiming.

production_reachability_rule: Code presence is insufficient. A capability is production-reachable only when typed configuration/application ownership, runtime execution, state/transaction ownership, qualification and production admission form an evidenced path. A restricted caller-supplied typed path is classified C rather than B when a normal broad application bootstrap/config route is absent.
